notes: Arena (formerly LMArena) Text, Text Coding and WebDev boards read 2026-10-13 for Gemini 4 Argon and the roster peers that have a row. Plain curl, headless Chrome and the fetch tool all hit a Cloudflare challenge today (403), so the rows come from a logged-in headed browser session: same-origin fetch of each board page, rows (rank, rank bounds, rating, 95% bounds, votes) parsed from the embedded RSC payload in code. The pages state no snapshot date, so snapshot ids use the retrieval date; Text overall is a new snapshot (the 2026-10-07 file used the board dated 2026-10-02, and peer ratings moved by a few points; use rows in the same snapshot only). Argon is listed as gemini-4-argon-high; other efforts are not listed. Arena's table lists Argon at $2 / $10 per M and 1M context. Argon text rows carry Arena's 'Preliminary' flag. New: Muse Wonder (max) is now on the Text and Text Coding boards (the 2026-10-13 Muse coverage file recorded it absent on a board stamped 2026-10-08), and Argon has a WebDev row. Preference Elo, not task success. Recheck on or after 2026-10-20.

Argon's lead over rank 2 is 12.1 points with overlapping intervals (rank spread 1 to 2). The 2026-10-07 file recorded Argon at 1525.2 (text) on the 2026-10-02 board; the new snapshot also re-rated peers (Opus 5.5 high 1503.70 on the 2026-10-02 board, 1508.08 now). Haiku 5.5 has no text-board row.

The 2026-10-07 file had Argon at 1560.2 with 1,230 votes (the vote count went down by 4 between reads; the board may have been re-computed). Arena WebDev, read the same day: Opus 5.5 max leads at 1811.15; Argon high is rank 9 at 1677.96 (interval 1662.6 to 1693.3, 1,772 votes), below Astra max 1780.24, Sonnet 5.5 xhigh 1773.66, Sol max 1760.09, Fable 5.1 max 1742.65 and Sonnet 5.5 high 1712.98, and above Muse Wonder max 1650.95 and Haiku 5.5 high 1585.03. Argon leads text and text-coding but not WebDev.

LABEL CONFLICT between Arena and Epoch: Epoch's page lists 'Text Arena (Coding)' for Argon as 1680 (raw 1679.5), but Epoch's own benchmark id for it is webdev_arena and its description says 'Previously known as WebDev Arena'. Arena's WebDev board gives Argon 1677.96 and Arena's Text Coding board gives 1560.58. The Epoch value matches WebDev, not Text Coding. The 2026-10-07 Epoch claim and the metric id epoch-text-arena-coding keep Epoch's label; do not compare that row with Arena Text Coding.
